FN-6YSYIZ1-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 343
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Jeff Sorrells
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 343 as introduced could decrease the administrative obligations of the Department of
Finance to hold public hearings for petitions by state rural electric authorities and electric
membership corporations to issue bonds or other evidences of indebtedness, which would no
longer be required under this bill.

electric authorities and electric membership corporations to issue bonds or other evidences of
indebtedness, which would no longer be required under this bill.
